An admin made bob an editor in the admin screen, but bob still cannot
publish: the publish button keeps failing until we restart the CMS. After a
restart it works.

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/cms/views/articles.py", line 88, in publish

  File "/srv/cms/vendor/accessctl/accessctl/access.py", line 26, in require
    raise PermissionDeniedError(f"{user} may not {permission}")
accessctl.access.PermissionDeniedError: bob may not publish

The CMS keeps one AccessControl for the whole process; the admin screen calls
roles.grant(user, role) on the same Roles object.
